method: git grep for gate names across tracked .py/.js, then traced which the real path imports (decision_engine/engine.py -> book_generator.py -> distributor.py -> orchestrator/engines/production.py). Full detail: reports/quality/existing_gates_audit.json

layers_found.name: profit_oracle.ladder_opportunity_score
layers_found.evidence: Nine hard gates incl. Proof of Payment (ADR-121). A niche is ACCEPTED only if it passes; otherwise DEFERRED/REJECTED.

layers_found.name: book_generator pre-generation checks (niche / competition)
layers_found.evidence: Returns passed=False; callers must not generate.

layers_found.name: inspectors.final_inspection (Dual Inspection)
layers_found.evidence: Cleared to publish only if both inspectors approve; missing inspectors -> fails closed; failures go to QUARANTINE.md.

layers_found.name: file_testing_engine.blocking_problems
layers_found.evidence: Opens the real delivered file before a real publish and blocks on certain defects.

layers_found.name: channels/write_gate
layers_found.evidence: Fails closed unless live flag/scope + VERIFIED fresh auth state (guards Gumroad writes).

layers_found.name: quality_enforcer (Core Value + Content Quality + Market Reality)
layers_found.evidence: Built + wired this sprint in orchestrator/engines/production.py::_pre_production_gate (Master Sprint A4). Layers 1+3 run before any generation; anything but APPROVED raises QualityGateBlocked. No override. Reuses file_testing_engine + market_evidence.

layers_found.name: quality_gate_policy.quality_gate_allowed (central publish gate)
layers_found.evidence: BLOCKS when consulted, but is consulted ONLY if the caller passes quality_gate / gate2_ledger_path / quality_evidence_path; the default real-publish path skips it.

layers_found.name: executive_quality_gate (REJECT_IF_FAIL checks)
layers_found.evidence: Used by reporting modules (brand_dna, commercial_readiness, digital_twin); not imported by the decision, production or publish path.

layers_found.name: product_readiness_score / launch_readiness
layers_found.evidence: Used by dashboards and reports only.

verdict_note: Real blocking gates already existed at decision, production and file level; the per-product Core Value / Content Quality / Market Reality checks did not, and the central publish gate was opt-in. This sprint added quality_enforcer (layers 1+3 wired pre-production) and dynamic_pricer; the central publish gate remains opt-in (a disclosed, unfixed gap).
gaps_closed: Per-product Core Value check before production (quality_enforcer layer 1).
Per-product Content Quality check tied to price (layer 2), spreadsheet-aware.
Per-product Market Reality check (layer 3) requiring sourced proof-of-payment / priced competitors.
Dynamic pricing with a 60% margin floor and 10%-below-cheapest-sourced-competitor rule (dynamic_pricer).
gaps_remaining: quality_gate_policy central publish gate is still opt-in on the default real-publish path.
No sourced competitor prices exist in the factory today, so Market Reality reports BLOCKED_MISSING_DATA for every current product.
